newsitem.title: UK: IBCA has no comment on Latvia ratings situation.
newsitem.headline: IBCA has no comment on Latvia ratings situation.

text.p: IBCA, the European rating agency, said on Monday it had no comment on whether it would be issuing sovereign credit ratings for Latvia.

The Latvian Finance Ministry earlier on Monday said IBCA had offered to give Latvia a rating but the country's finance minister, Robert Zile, had not yet accepted the offer, saying Latvia may be interested but only if big Latvian banks were also interested.

An IBCA official confirmed a meeting with Latvia had taken place but said the agency had no other comment. Asked if there were any plans for announcments on Latvia, the official said, "Not at this point."
Latvia has an investment grade rating of BBB from Standard & Poor's.
